name: Zankaja
summary: In Orgrimmar, young orc woman Zankaja waits anxiously for word of her mate, Dogran. He was assigned to duty at the Crossroads, along the dangerous frontier of the Barrens.

sections.title: A Watchful Heart
sections.body: Zankaja waits for news of Dogran, her mate, in Orgrimmar. Dogran earned a promotion and went south to bolster the outpost at the Crossroads in the Barrens. The assignment honors a warrior, but the frontier is harsh, with quilboar, centaur, and aggressive beasts. When Dogran failed to send word or return as expected, Zankaja began asking travelers to seek news of him.

sections.title: Tragic Tidings
sections.body: News from the Barrens brings Zankaja's worst fear: Dogran fell into the clutches of the quilboar. She still holds hope within Orgrimmar's canyon walls, though the frontier is unforgiving. The news travelers bring paints a grim picture of sacrifice on the Horde's perilous borders.

faq.answer: Zankaja lives along the path between the Valley of Strength and the Valley of Wisdom in Orgrimmar.
Dogran is Zankaja's mate, an orc warrior whose recent promotion sent him to a station at the Crossroads in the Barrens.
Dogran was sent to duty at the Crossroads in the harsh Barrens, then failed to return or send word home. Zankaja fears harm has come to him on the frontier.

faq.q: What does Zankaja ask adventurers to do?
faq.answer: Zankaja asks passing adventurers heading out of Orgrimmar to visit Captain Gazrog at the Crossroads and ask about Dogran's whereabouts and wellbeing.

faq.q: What happened to Dogran in the Barrens?
faq.answer: Zankaja does not know what happened to Dogran in the Barrens. She asks travelers to speak with Gazrog at the Crossroads and follow the trail from there.

angles.text: As an orc, you can see the personal cost to ordinary families in Durotar, where duty to the Warchief's new realm sends loved ones into untamed, lethal frontiers.
As a member of the Horde, you can see in Zankaja's plea that holding outposts like the Crossroads costs real blood and sacrifice from the grunts stationed there.
